joinText: Pick only the branches you care about; their posts show up on your home. You can change them any time.
manageText: Add or remove branches, then save.
noneHint: No branches: you'll only get {{name}} posts that aren't in a specific branch.
welcomeText: Every track has branches (smaller communities). Pick only what you care about, or leave it empty to get the track's general posts.
panelHint: Tick the branches whose posts you want, and press the arrow to open a branch.
